Name: Clint Removes Apron (Slightly Cuter Sprites)
Author: somohexual
Description: It bothered me that Clint always wore his big, heavy blacksmith apron everywhere so I made this quick alteration. I tweaked his face a bit and he now only wears his apron while smashing Geodes or working at his forge.

Downloads.Description: Edits Clint's sprite from Slightly Cuter Character Sprites so that he only wears his big bulky apron while smashing Geodes and working at his forge.
